svg.title: Shoga-Speaks
svg.desc: A green Kashmiri parrot on a chinar branch at dusk asks "Did you understand?" in Roman-Urdu, Urdu, Hindi, English and Dutch, while a Claude Code terminal answers a question in Roman-Urdu and unfolds the English. Shoga-Speaks is a Claude Code plugin that explains things in your language, your script and for your role.

g.text: ● Release mat karein. Do problems hain:
· SQL injection: data leak ho sakta hai
· N+1 query: 500 orders pe page slow

text.tspan: Don't release: a data-leak risk and a
page that gets slow with 500+ orders.

g.text: Roman-Urdu · اردو · Hinglish · हिन्दी · Nederlands · English
